data.description:
## Incident Overview
### Expected Behavior
tests/workflows/test-llm-review-liveness.sh passes on origin/main.

### Actual Behavior
2/14 assertions FAIL on a clean origin/main checkout (PASSED:12 FAILED:2), independent of any working-tree change:
- 'per-branch-review.yml has no liveness-assertion step'
- 'per-branch-review.yml liveness step does not assert /tmp/findings.json + findings'

Root: .github/workflows/per-branch-review.yml no longer exists (removed/renamed during the two-tier promotion migration — review now runs via ci.yml's review-sub-pr / llm-review jobs). The test still asserts a liveness step inside per-branch-review.yml. The liveness assertion itself MOVED to ci.yml (the 'Assert review liveness' step calling assert-review-liveness.sh); the test's file target is stale.

### Evidence
Confirmed pre-existing via git stash of unrelated changes -> same 12/2 result. Discovered while re-baselining allowlist tests for story 3783 (unrelated; 3783 touches only the allowlist + classification consumers).

### Suggested Fix
Repoint the test's per-branch-review.yml assertions at ci.yml's 'Assert review liveness' step (assert-review-liveness.sh invocation), or delete the obsolete assertions if ci.yml's liveness coverage is tested elsewhere (test-assert-review-liveness.sh exists and passes).
data.title: [test-llm-review-liveness]: asserts liveness step in removed per-branch-review.yml -> 2 failures on main
